A '''laser turret''' was a [[Turret/Legends|turret]]-mounted [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weapon that could be used as a ground emplacement or vehicle or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weapon. One model was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The guns were used by the Republic during the [[Invasion of Begeren]] alongside [[Cacophanizer Shells]]. They were used to destroy squads three, eight, and fifteen of the Sith Empire's attack force. They also pinned down squad seventeen and [[Qawohl]]. They were presumably destroyed or captured when the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] won the battle.

[[Quad laser cannon/Legends|Quad laser cannon]] turrets were equipped onto the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="SWE Millennium Falcon">{{SWE|technology|millenniumfalcon|''Millennium Falcon''}}</ref>
